options.content: **Automated Documents** = Documents where `auto_processed = true`, OR documents that moved out of `ready_for_validation` status within **5 seconds** of reaching it (no manual intervention required). Org lists and time range are controlled by the dashboard time picker and the `org_*` variables below.

targets.rawSql:
WITH status_changes AS (
    SELECT
        org_id,
        doc_id,
        current_status,
        created_on,
        LEAD(created_on) OVER (PARTITION BY doc_id ORDER BY created_on) AS next_created_on
    FROM public.document_log
    WHERE is_deleted = FALSE
      AND $__timeFilter(created_on)
),
qualified AS (
    SELECT
        sc.org_id,
        sc.doc_id,
        d.doc_type,
        d.auto_processed,
        (sc.next_created_on IS NOT NULL AND EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (sc.next_created_on - sc.created_on)) < 5) AS fast_transition
    FROM status_changes sc
    JOIN public.documents d ON sc.doc_id = d.id
    WHERE sc.current_status = 'ready_for_validation'
)
SELECT
    ROUND(
        (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE q.auto_processed IS TRUE OR q.fast_transition)::NUMERIC * 100)
        / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0),
        1
    ) AS "Automation Rate"
FROM qualified q
JOIN public.organisation_cache oc ON q.org_id = oc.id
WHERE oc.name IN ($org_prod_eu);

WITH status_changes AS (
    SELECT
        org_id,
        doc_id,
        current_status,
        created_on,
        LEAD(created_on) OVER (PARTITION BY doc_id ORDER BY created_on) AS next_created_on
    FROM public.document_log
    WHERE is_deleted = FALSE
      AND $__timeFilter(created_on)
),
qualified AS (
    SELECT
        sc.org_id,
        sc.doc_id,
        d.doc_type,
        d.auto_processed,
        (sc.next_created_on IS NOT NULL AND EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (sc.next_created_on - sc.created_on)) < 5) AS fast_transition
    FROM status_changes sc
    JOIN public.documents d ON sc.doc_id = d.id
    WHERE sc.current_status = 'ready_for_validation'
),
automated_counts AS (
    SELECT
        oc.name AS org_name,
        q.doc_type,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE q.auto_processed IS TRUE OR q.fast_transition) AS automated_documents_count
    FROM qualified q
    JOIN public.organisation_cache oc ON q.org_id = oc.id
    WHERE oc.name IN ($org_prod_eu)
    GROUP BY oc.name, q.doc_type
    HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE q.auto_processed IS TRUE OR q.fast_transition) > 0
)
SELECT
    org_name AS "Organization",
    doc_type AS "Document Type",
    automated_documents_count AS "Automated Documents Count",
    ROUND(
        (automated_documents_count::NUMERIC * 100) / SUM(automated_documents_count) OVER (),
        2
    )::TEXT || '%' AS "Automation Share Percent"
FROM automated_counts
ORDER BY "Organization", "Automated Documents Count" DESC;

FROM public.organisation_cache oc
JOIN public.document_log dl ON oc.id = dl.org_id
WHERE dl.is_deleted = FALSE

ORDER BY oc.name;
